description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PdfItem' that serves as the foundation for all PDF object types within the PdfSharp library. It provides cloning functionality and an abstract method for writing the object to a PDF writer.

classes.name: PdfItem
classes.description: An abstract base class representing all PDF objects and simple PDF types within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this PdfItem instance by invoking the copy mechanism.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: An overridable method that performs the actual copying of the object. Defaults to a shallow copy via MemberwiseClone.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: An abstract method that must be overridden in derived classes to append a string representation of the object to a PdfWriter.
